title: Data Scientist Consultant for Supply Chain
description:
About Accenture Data \& AI for Supply Chain Team


We are a global Center of Excellence specializing in Data \& AI for Supply Chain, with a rapidly growing team of 180\+ professionals. Our mission is to turn data into a strategic advantage, driving operational excellence, agility, and smarter, faster decision\-making across the end\-to\-end supply chain.


As we continue to expand, we are looking for passionate professionals to join our team and shape the future of intelligent supply chains.


Our Focus Areas

* Supply Chain Planning – AI\-driven demand forecasting, inventory optimization, and planning solutions to enhance agility and efficiency.
* Fulfillment \& Network Optimization – Advanced analytics to optimize logistics, warehouse management, distribution, network and last\-mile delivery, improving speed, cost, and service levels.
* Manufacturing – AI, machine learning, and IoT to drive predictive maintenance, production efficiency, and quality control in smart manufacturing.


Your role


As a Data Scientist in Accenture’s Data \& AI for Supply Chain team, you will:

* Apply AI, advanced analytics, and optimization techniques to solve complex supply chain challenges.
* Engage directly with clients, translating business needs into AI\-driven solutions and delivering measurable impact.
* Drive business development, contributing to proposals, identifying new opportunities, and shaping innovative AI offerings.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, including data scientists, engineers, and business consultants, to implement cutting\-edge supply chain solutions

  

What Skills Are We Looking For?


Basic Qualifications:


✔ Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. ✔ Proficiency in English (additional languages are a plus). ✔ 3\-4\+ years of experience in Data \& AI or related fields (we are hiring at different experience levels).


We seek professionals with strong expertise in AI, analytics, and optimization applied to supply chain challenges. While you don’t need to master all of them, experience in multiple areas will be highly valuable. Key skills include:

* Programming: Python, R, SQL
* Operation Reasearch \& Simulation: LP, ILP, Heuristics/Meta\-Heuristics, Discrete Events Simulation, digital twins.
* Machine Learning \& AI: Forecasting, predictive modeling, optimization algorithms.
* Generative AI: LLMs, AI\-driven scenario generation, synthetic data modeling, and workflow automation.
* Cloud \& Big Data: Experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP, including AI/ML services.
* Supply Chain Solutions: Familiarity with o9, Blue Yonder (BY), SAP IBP, or similar tools.
* Data Engineering \& Visualization: Large\-scale data processing, market solutions/platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, ..), and tools like Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.


Soft \& Strategic Skills


Beyond technical expertise, we look for professionals who can think strategically, collaborate effectively, and drive impact in complex environments. Key skills include:

* Problem\-Solving \& Critical Thinking: Ability to analyze supply chain challenges and design AI\-driven solutions.
* Business Acumen: Understanding the impact of AI and analytics on supply chain efficiency, resilience, and cost reduction.
* Communication \& Stakeholder Management: Ability to translate complex data insights into actionable business recommendations for technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Agility \& Innovation: Comfortable working in fast\-paced, evolving environments, with a passion for continuous learning and innovation.


What’s in It for You?


Join Accenture’s Data \& AI for Supply Chain team and unlock a challenging and rewarding career, where you will:

* Work on high\-impact AI \& analytics projects with global clients.
* Collaborate with a team of 180\+ data scientists and engineers, including 20% PhDs in Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, or Statistics.
* Drive cutting\-edge AI innovation, including Generative AI applications in supply chain.
* Enjoy a flexible, hybrid work model in a Great Place to Work®\-recognized company.


The position is based in Barcelona or Madrid in a hybrid work model, combining remote work with in\-office collaboration to foster team synergy. Candidates must reside in Spain and have legal work authorization.


At Accenture, recognized as a Great Place To Work®, we embrace a hybrid work model that leverages technology and our facilities to maintain essential human connection with our teams and clients. This connection supports our culture of inclusion and diversity, making us, according to Refinitiv, the most diverse company in the world.


We also offer benefits such as:

* Health, life, and accident insurance
* Medical services and wellness programs
* Flexible compensation and stock purchase plans
* Flexibility programs (working hours, time off, vacation)
* Personalized training paths
* Sustainability initiatives and Accenture Foundation programs
* Employee diversity networks
* Additional benefits: Bankinter office with special conditions and profit sharing


If you are excited about leading AI\-driven transformations in supply chain, we’d love to hear from you!

description:
OCT 10, 2025


Do you want to strategically design and architect comprehensive technical solutions that integrate multiple marketing technologies to create cohesive, hyper\-personalized customer journeys for some of the world's largest brands? Are you driven by transforming complex business needs into innovative, scalable, and future\-proof solutions across leading CRM and marketing automation platforms? Then you might be just the Solutions Architect we’re looking for!


**What will your day look like?**



As our new Solutions Architect \-specialising in adobe campaign, you will be responsible for supervising the architecture of full solutions, including all products used within a marketing cloud and related integrations. You will act as a strategic technical leader, working closely with stakeholders to understand complex business needs and develop technical documentation and solutions that align with those needs across multiple marketing technologies. Your role will involve ensuring data consistency, accuracy, and compliance with data privacy regulations across integrated systems.



More specifically, you will:


* Strategically design and architect blueprints for projects that involve one or more products within a single marketing cloud (adobe), always maximizing marketing effectiveness and efficiency.
* Design data integrations between different marketing technologies, ensuring data is consistent, accurate, and complies with data privacy regulations across systems.
* Evaluate new technologies and tools to determine their potential impact on existing systems and provide strategic recommendations.
* Design solutions that enable data to be analyzed across multiple marketing technologies, providing actionable insights.
* Ensure that technical solutions are properly utilized together, leveraging the unique capabilities from each platform and ensuring configurations address specific business requirements in accordance with the client strategy.
* Manage data \& system governance and integrations for the corresponding marketing cloud, ensuring the future\-proofing of products and operations in scope.
* Propose ideas for improving or optimizing existing integrated marketing solutions, including the utilization of new features and modules.
* Ensure solutions adhere to data security standards, privacy regulations (such as GDPR and CCPA), and company policies.
* Solve complex challenges that involve multiple products, focusing on scalability and performance, with a client\-minded approach.
* Identify and resolve technical issues that may arise within the marketing technology ecosystem, often acting as a point of escalation for complex problems.
* Collaborate with different client departments to understand their goals, challenges, and processes, and translate these requirements into technical solutions that apply across multiple products.
* Identify opportunities for system enhancements, staying aware of the latest MarTech trends (per industry) to continuously drive innovation.
* Elaborate architecture solutions and diagrams for covering complex client use cases.
* Build impact assessments to identify the feasibility of certain solutions and measure improvement uplift.
* Design and operationalize batch, stream, and real\-time data integrations.

You join the technical leadership team, collaborating closely with Architects, Developers, and Technical Project Managers within our 100\+ strong technical department. You will also work extensively with account teams, Data Specialists, and our clients’ technical leadership, acting as a key technical liaison.



We value room for diversity, and you will get a chance to put a personal touch on your daily tasks while developing your professional skillset. We are proud of our multicultural environment and easy\-going, dynamic atmosphere where we not only work together – we are great at having fun as well.


**What do you bring to the table?**



As a person, you are a **strategic thinker, a proactive problem\-solver, and an influential communicator** who can articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences. You possess a deep understanding of the entire project lifecycle and can translate sophisticated business requirements into robust, scalable, and integrated technical solutions. You are adept at utilizing all MAP expertise and WoW to support client technical leadership.



In addition, you have:


* 7\+ years of progressive experience in a Solutions Architect or Lead Technical Consultant role, with extensive experience in Adobe campaign.
* Proven experience in strategic technical planning, including vendor investigation, evaluation, and recommendations.
* Deep expertise in designing and integrating multiple marketing technologies (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud with other CRM, analytics, or advertising platforms).
* Extensive knowledge of technologies such as SQL, XML, JSON, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and proficiency in one or more programming languages.
* Expertise in Workflow Engines, advanced database design and modeling, and data governance best practices.
* Demonstrated ability to lead client\-facing engagements, manage complex project deadlines, and ensure solutions are delivered within agreed budgets and scope.
* A strong understanding of data security standards, privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA), and their application in marketing technology solutions.
* A track record of identifying opportunities for system enhancements and driving innovation by staying abreast of the latest MarTech trends.


**A leader in personalized customer experiences**

With the brain of a consultancy, the heart of an agency and the power of technology and data, we work with some of the world's most admired brands to help them on their transformation journey to becoming truly customer\-centric. title: Data Scientist in Digital Health – AI Factories (RE2)
description:
**Job Reference**
-----------------


602\_25\_LS\_DHU\_RE2
**Position**
------------


Data Scientist in Digital Health – AI Factories (RE2\)
**Closing Date**
----------------


Sunday, 26 October, 2025
**Reference:** 602\_25\_LS\_DHU\_RE2
**Job title:** Data Scientist in Digital Health – AI Factories (RE2\)  


**About BSC**
The Barcelona Supercomputing Center \- Centro Nacional de Supercomputación (BSC\-CNS) is the leading supercomputing center in Spain. It houses MareNostrum, one of the most powerful supercomputers in Europe, was a founding and hosting member of the former European HPC infrastructure PRACE (Partnership for Advanced Computing in Europe), and is now hosting entity for EuroHPC JU, the Joint Undertaking that leads large\-scale investments and HPC provision in Europe. The mission of BSC is to research, develop and manage information technologies in order to facilitate scientific progress. BSC combines HPC service provision and R\&D into both computer and computational science (life, earth and engineering sciences) under one roof, and currently has over 1000 staff from 60 countries.  

  

Look at the BSC experience:  

BSC\-CNS YouTube Channel  

Let's stay connected with BSC Folks!  

  

We are particularly interested for this role in the strengths and lived experiences of women and underrepresented groups to help us avoid perpetuating biases and oversights in science and IT research. In instances of equal merit, the incorporation of the under\-represented sex will be favoured.  

  

We promote Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, fostering an environment where each and every one of us is appreciated for who we are, regardless of our differences.  

  

If you consider that you do not meet all the requirements, we encourage you to continue applying for the job offer. We value diversity of experiences and skills, and you could bring unique perspectives to our team.
**Context And Mission**
The Barcelona Supercomputing Center – Centro Nacional de Supercomputación (BSC\-CNS) is Europe’s leading center for supercomputing research. The successful candidate will work in a highly sophisticated HPC environment, have access to state\-of\-the\-art systems and computational infrastructures, and establish collaborations with experts and companies in different areas at the local and international levels.  

  

The AI Factory is a large\-scale initiative led by the Barcelona Supercomputing Center – Centro Nacional de Supercomputación (BSC\-CNS), designed to position Europe at the forefront of global AI development and deployment. With a multi\-stakeholder approach, the AI Factory aims to lower the barriers to AI innovation by offering access to state\-of\-the\-art AI computing infrastructure, advanced training programs, and a dynamic innovation ecosystem. The initiative supports start\-ups, SMEs, corporates, academia, and public institutions, providing tailored support to boost AI capabilities and promote responsible and impactful AI adoption.  

  

The Digital Health Unit, led by Dr. Paula Petrone, contributes to this mission by applying AI and data science to healthcare and biotechnology. The selected candidate will develop novel approaches to advance medical practice and will support collaborations with startups, companies, and clinical researchers, ensuring that AI innovations translate into healthcare impact.  

  

We encourage applications from all genders and candidates from underrepresented groups.
This project is funded by the European Union’s Recovery and Resilience Facility, in accordance with Council Regulation (EU) 2020/2094 of 14 December 2020, and regulated by Regulation (EU) 2021/241 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 12 February 2021, in the context of the “BSC AI Factory” project.
The BSC AI Factory project has received funding from the European High\-Performance Computing Joint Undertaking (JU) under grant agreement No 101234399\. The JU receives support from the European Union’s Horizon Europe Programme and Spain, Portugal, and Türkiye.  


**Key Duties**
* Develop AI methods for health applications, with emphasis on:  

o Deep learning architectures (transformers, generative AI, agentic AI)  

o Multimodal learning (medical imaging, omics, EHRs, wearables, etc.)  

o NLP for biomedical and clinical data
* Support AI Factory users (startups, SMEs, corporates, academia, public institutions) in building early\-stage AI healthcare applications.
* Provide data science consulting and strategic input to projects in medicine and biotechnology.
* Attend and contribute to entrepreneurship and innovation training (business planning, investor pitching, startup development, data science strategy).
* Publish research results and present at international conferences.
* Participate in outreach and dissemination within the AI Factories innovation ecosystem.


**Requirements**
* Education
	+ Master’s degree in Computer Science, Biomedical Sciences, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, or related fields.
	+ PhD is welcome (plus), but not required.
* Essential Knowledge and Professional Experience
	+ Expertise in machine learning / deep learning applied to biomedical or healthcare data.
	+ Strong programming skills (Python, R, etc.).
	+ Familiarity with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow).
	+ Strong interest in entrepreneurship and innovation ecosystems (training will be provided).
* Additional Knowledge and Professional Experience
	+ Hands\-on experience with transformers, generative AI, agentic AI, medical imaging, NLP, or multimodal AI.
	+ Familiarity with HPC environments or large\-scale data infrastructures.
* Competences
	+ Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
	+ Ability to interact with clinical, academic, and industrial partners.
	+ Fluency in English, Catalan, and Spanish.

**Conditions**
* The position will be located at BSC within the Life Sciences Department
* We offer a full\-time contract (37\.5h/week), a good working environment, a highly stimulating environment with state\-of\-the\-art infrastructure, flexible working hours, extensive training plan, restaurant tickets, private health insurance, support to the relocation procedures
* Duration: Open\-ended contract due to technical and scientific activities linked to the project and budget duration
* Holidays: 23 paid vacation days plus 24th and 31st of December per our collective agreement
* Salary: we offer a competitive salary commensurate with the qualifications and experience of the candidate and according to the cost of living in Barcelona
* Starting date: asap


**Applications procedure and process**
All applications must be submitted via the BSC website and contain:  

* A full CV in English including contact details
* A cover/motivation letter with a statement of interest in English, clearly specifying for which specific area and topics the applicant wishes to be considered. Additionally, two references for further contacts must be included. Applications without this document will not be considered.

  

**Development of the recruitment process**

  

  

The selection will be carried out through a competitive examination system ("Concurso\-Oposición"). The recruitment process consists of two phases:  

* **Curriculum Analysis:** Evaluation of previous experience and/or scientific history, degree, training, and other professional information relevant to the position. \- ***40 points***
* **Interview phase:** The highest\-rated candidates at the curriculum level will be invited to the interview phase, conducted by the corresponding department and Human Resources. In this phase, technical competencies, knowledge, skills, and professional experience related to the position, as well as the required personal competencies, will be evaluated. \- ***60 points.*** *A minimum of 30 points out of 60 must be obtained to be eligible for the position.*

  

  

The recruitment panel will be composed of at least three people, ensuring at least 25% representation of women.

  

In accordance with OTM\-R principles, a gender\-balanced recruitment panel is formed for each vacancy at the beginning of the process. After reviewing the content of the applications, the panel will begin the interviews, with at least one technical and one administrative interview. At a minimum, a personality questionnaire as well as a technical exercise will be conducted during the process.

  

The panel will make a final decision, and all individuals who participated in the interview phase will receive feedback with details on the acceptance or rejection of their profile.

  


At BSC, we seek continuous improvement in our recruitment processes. For any suggestions or comments/complaints about our recruitment processes, please contact recruitment \[at] bsc \[dot] es.  

For more information, please follow this link.

  


**Deadline**
The vacancy will remain open until a suitable candidate has been hired. Applications will be regularly reviewed and potential candidates will be contacted.

**OTM\-R principles for selection processes**
BSC\-CNS is committed to the principles of the Code of Conduct for the Recruitment of Researchers of the European Commission and the Open, Transparent and Merit\-based Recruitment principles (OTM\-R). This is applied for any potential candidate in all our processes, for example by creating gender\-balanced recruitment panels and recognizing career breaks etc.  

BSC\-CNS is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We are pleased to consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or any other basis protected by applicable state or local law.

Are you motivated by the opportunity to lead the development of our financial risk management data and functionality? This is a key technical leadership role within the Financial Markets Department of New Zealand's central bank.

The Portfolio Risk team ensure that financial risks to the RBNZ's balance sheet are identified, measured, monitored and managed in line with the Bank's risk appetite. It is critical that this is enabled by robust data, systems and functionality.
  

  

The team ensure that risks are communicated effectively measured, managed and understood, providing day\-to\-day support to portfolio managers and supporting oversight by senior management, Assets and Liabilities Committee and the Board. The team also contribute to broader work, supporting the RBNZ's strategic objectives and effective management of its balance sheet.
  

  

In this role you will:


* Lead the maintenance of our data, systems and coding infrastructure, and developing functionality and quantitative finance capability
* Lead uplift initiatives and strategic financial risk management projects
* Work collaboratively with colleagues across the RBNZ and build strong relationships
* Help to lead a great team, including coaching and developing others.

You will:


* Be an experienced financial market professional, data scientist or central banker with strong quantitative and programming skills.
* Have in\-depth knowledge of balance sheets, risk modelling, data and systems, and/or financial instruments.
